subject: Linguistics
title: Phrases and Clauses
description: A short lesson to help you apply Phrases and Clauses.

hook.text: 'The big red ball' works as a unit—you can move it around a sentence as one piece.

buildup.text: A phrase is a group of words acting as a single grammatical unit with a head word.

discovery.text: A clause goes further—it contains a subject and a predicate and can express a full idea.

twist.text: Sentences can nest clauses inside clauses, theoretically forever.

climax.text: This recursion is what lets you build infinite meaning from finite grammar.

punchline.text: Phrases build clauses; clauses build worlds.
